change_note: 2026-11.3 (CE-ADR-022, Amaru 2026-11-13): first emails only from APPROVED research briefs (named person on the company's domain, a fact under 90 days old with its source, a doubt-phrased hypothesis, one question about past behaviour, why now), drafted by a model from the brief alone and checked by the personalization gate. Templates are structure only for the first email. 5 first emails per business day; one active lane, es_odoo_partners, until 2027-02-06; ES/EU/UK/CA manual outreach. Only DTE Chile may be claimed among e-invoicing localizations; CFDI, SUNAT, DIAN and Verifactu are not claimed. Citable cases: the nutrition practice (Odoo 16 + React) and Qué Compro; the psychotherapy clinic and BoRo OS are not cited. Follow-ups carry no technical claim.

odoo_partner.es: Cuando un partner Odoo tiene más proyectos que equipo, lo técnico suele ser lo primero que se atrasa: un módulo, una integración, un ajuste de {loc_short}.
